original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚三角洲州校车司机因涉嫌绑架并性侵未成年人被捕
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚三角洲州警方逮捕28岁校车司机Onome Ughagha，其被指在萨佩莱绑架并性侵一名14岁女学生。据称嫌疑人向学生父亲索要并收取了50.3万奈拉赎金，随后将受害者遗弃在Oton路。警方发言人表示，案件于2026年10月20日由受害者父亲报案。目前信息仅来自单一来源，相关指控尚未经证实。

location.raw_text: Sapele, Delta State, along Oton Road

key_facts.fact: 三角洲州警方逮捕28岁校车司机Onome Ughagha
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A 28-year-old school bus driver, Onome Ughagha, has been arrested by operatives of the Delta State Police Command

key_facts.fact: 嫌疑人被指绑架并性侵一名14岁女学生
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: for allegedly kidnapping and sexually assaulting a 14-year-old female student in Sapele

key_facts.fact: 嫌疑人被指索要并收取50.3万奈拉赎金后将受害者遗弃在Oton路
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The suspect allegedly demanded and collected ₦503,000 in ransom from the student’s father before abandoning her along Oton Road, Sapele

key_facts.fact: 案件于2026年10月20日由受害者父亲向萨佩莱地区指挥部报案
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the incident was reported at the Sapele Area Command on October 20, 2026, by the victim’s father

uncertainties: 绑架与性侵指控目前仅为据称，尚未经证实
信息仅来自单一来源（Punch），尚缺乏交叉验证
赎金金额及案件细节有待进一步核实
